blurb: A `type` takes `@discriminator("…")` (on a sum), and a sum's variant takes `@name("…")`. Any other annotation in those places would do nothing, so it is refused rather than ignored. Remove it, or use one of the two.
example:
type Shape =
    | @label("round") Circle(r: Int)    // ✗ not a variant annotation
    | Square(side: Int)

type Shape =
    | @name("round") Circle(r: Int)    // ✓
    | Square(side: Int)
summary: A type or a sum variant carries an annotation other than `@discriminator("…")` on a type or `@name("…")` on a variant.
